author: Yffe
content: Failing test at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_spec_call_bool_arg_cast.rs::{spec_call_bool_binary_arg_takes_no_cast,spec_call_bool_unary_arg_takes_no_cast} demonstrates divergence. req s_b(x, x < y) emits s_b(x, (x < y) as u64); req s_b(1, !flag) emits s_b(1, (!flag) as u64) — verus E0308 expected bool found u64, live-confirmed. Surface unary set is exactly Not (REQ-10 #92), so EVERY Expr::Unary arg is bool-typed; the #225 'bool arm is defensive' premise is false. All spec_call_param_cast consumer sites affected (lower_expr Call arm + lower_inv_expr Call arm).
